# Stale Test Assertions

Tests may be marked as covering components, but if the tests haven't been executed after the last change to the component, they may assert outdated behavior. This is particularly risky when changes occur frequently.

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/queries.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.queries.coverage_for`
